typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchiveFile_PA as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	EmailRecipients as string (),
	EmailRecipientsCC as string (),
	EnvironmentCode as string (),
	ErrorEmailRecipients as string (),
	ErrorEmailRecipientsCC as string (),
	ErrorFile as string (),
	ErrorFileName as string (),
	ErrorPath as string (),
	FileLayoutCD as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FileName_PA as string (),
	File_IID as integer (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportFile_PA as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	MarketID as string (),
	RecordsImported as integer (),
	RecordsInSrcFile as integer (),
	RecordsWithLongMemberId as integer (),
	TimeStamp as string ()
}

source(output(
		MemberID as string,
		AuthID as string,
		AuthStatus as string,
		ProviderID as string,
		UrgentIndicator as string,
		AUTHTYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource split(length(MemberID) > 11, disjoint: true) ~> CheckFieldLength@(FieldTooLong,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
CheckFieldLength@FieldTooLong derive(Errors = (iif(length(MemberID) > 11, 'Member ID Too Long, ', ''))) ~> AddErrorsField
AddErrorsField derive(ErrorsWithoutTrailingComma = left(Errors, length(Errors) - 2)) ~> AddErrorsFieldWithoutTrailingComma
AddErrorsFieldWithoutTrailingComma sink(input(
		ProviderID as string,
		MemberID as string,
		AuthID as string,
		AUTHTYPE as string,
		Errors as string,
		AuthStatus as string,
		UrgentIndicator as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ProviderID,
		MemberID,
		AuthID,
		AUTHTYPE,
		Errors = ErrorsWithoutTrailingComma,
		AuthStatus,
		UrgentIndicator)) ~> ErrorFlatFile
